item.text: `getPersistedSessions()` already normalizes persisted records and includes `localID`; it safely skips malformed JSON but can throw when storage itself is inaccessible. I’ll choose the highest `persistedAt` result and report failures from storage enumeration. The requested `LAST_ACTIVE_PING` removal reaches the old session-selection logic; the active ping hook itself also stores that key, so I’m removing that local tracking and its cleanup while preserving the API activity ping.
